component.title: AsyncBoundary
component.purpose: One stable, accessible region for loading, refresh, stale, partial, offline, and recoverable failure states.

states.description: Delayed initial loading with structure-matching skeletons.
Freshness work is visible without removing useful content.
Saved content remains available while its freshness is communicated.
A recoverable section failure does not erase the successful content.
Offline context is distinct from an application failure and preserves cached content.
A failure has an understandable message and a keyboard-accessible retry.
Ready content renders in the same named region.

claims.statement: AsyncBoundary keeps a single bounded region while state messaging changes.
Refresh-like states preserve useful content and avoid avoidable layout collapse.
Loading and failure states expose live semantics, descriptive copy, and a focusable retry path.
Loading motion and retry transitions settle without animation under reduced-motion preferences.
